E2934

This constraint repeats one already written in this `Layout{{ … }}` body

What

This constraint repeats one already written in this `Layout{{ … }}` body

Why

An exact duplicate constraint doesn't tighten the layout — it's almost always a copy-paste leftover.

Fix

remove the duplicate line, or change it if a different constraint was meant.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2934: tests/ui_lint/layout_redundant_constraint.warn.

Warning [E2934] (duplicate_layout_constraint): this constraint repeats one already written in this `Layout.{ … }` body
  --> tests/ui_lint/layout_redundant_constraint.jet:6:15
    |
  6 |         label.width >= Float{80.0}
    |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: an exact duplicate constraint doesn't tighten the layout — it's almost always a copy-paste leftover
 Fix: remove the duplicate line, or change it if a different constraint was meant
